orientations.intent: Can this repository reader open the host filesystem path C:/licenses/ink.txt? I want to determine the capability boundary of this tool.

final_message:
No — the repository reader cannot open that path.

**Capability boundary:** The tool operates only within the reachable repository world exposed via the handle; it has no access to arbitrary host filesystem paths like `C:/licenses/ink.txt`. That path isn't part of the granted capability set, so the request was flatly unmatched ("requested capability is unavailable in the reachable world") — no partial read, no error leak of host details, just a clean refusal at the boundary. If `ink.txt` is meant to be inspected, it would need to be part of the repository content itself (accessible via a repo-relative path within the granted scope), not an absolute host OS path.
